title: ever LARK|Pleated Chiffon Ruffles Sleeve Midi Semi Formal Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your evening look with this chiffon midi dress. The pleated bodice flatters your figure, while the delicate ruffled sleeves add a romantic touch. Designed with comfort and grace in mind, its flowing A-line silhouette ensures ease of movement. Perfect for weddings, cocktail parties, or any special occasion.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length:Tea length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
